properties.description: Classify every divergence between two as-designed records as function-bearing, structural, or unclassified, and return a verdict — preserved / not_preserved / indeterminate — naming the invariant checked and what the check could not see. Function is the Capability and Requirement population plus the SATISFIES links between them; structure is allocation, containment, interfaces and the seams between components. Unclassified never passes: an unrecognised divergence makes the verdict indeterminate, so a classifier that has not been taught a new part of the vocabulary cannot certify a design it never examined.
properties.name: Certify that a restructuring preserved function
